transformations: Decoded common HTML entities and normalized whitespace in text fields.
Rewrote program_url host from findit-dev.ddev.site to www.finditcambridge.org while preserving each page path.
Split Registration URL into registration_web_url and registration_link_text.
Deduplicated repeated semicolon-delimited taxonomy/list values while preserving source order.
Added static geocoded latitude, longitude, point geometry, and Socrata region ids for map exploration.
Sorted rows by organization, title, and program_id for stable display.

columns.description: Unique Find It Cambridge source node identifier for the program page. Stored as text because it is an identifier, not a numeric measure.
Program page title displayed on Find It Cambridge.
Public URL for the Find It Cambridge page. The source export used a local development host; only the host was rewritten.
Publication status in the source export. This prototype includes only records whose source status is Published.
Date the program page was created in the source system, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD.
Date the program page was last updated in the source system, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD.
Organization associated with the program page.
Location information as provided by Find It Cambridge. Some programs list multiple locations or virtual-only details.
Short public summary of the program.
Longer public description of the program, with common HTML entities decoded for readability.
Current Find It Cambridge service/category tags from the Services (2023) source field; values are semicolon-delimited when multiple tags apply.
Age ranges served by the program; values are semicolon-delimited when multiple ages/ranges apply.
Grade levels served by the program; values are semicolon-delimited when multiple grades apply.
Eligibility notes or restrictions for the program.
Free-text cost information supplied by the program.
Cost or subsidy tags such as free, aid, vouchers, scale, or some; values are semicolon-delimited when multiple tags apply.
Registration mode from Find It Cambridge, such as registration, application, optional, or none.
Extracted web URL from the source registration link field when a web URL was present.
Human-readable registration link label or original non-web registration link text.
Additional registration instructions or notes.
Broad timing category from Find It Cambridge, such as ongoing, school, summer, or between.
Days of week when the program is available; values are semicolon-delimited when multiple days apply.
Times of day when the program is available; values are semicolon-delimited when multiple times apply.
Additional notes about schedule, seasonality, or timing.
Virtual availability value from Find It Cambridge. Values distinguish in-person/no virtual option, online, and online-only records where available.
Transportation availability values from Find It Cambridge; values are semicolon-delimited when multiple options apply.
Accessibility, language, childcare, or refreshment accommodations listed for the program.
Public contact name or contact channel listed for the program.
Additional public contact notes.
Latitude returned by the geocoding source for the selected location segment. Blank when no location was supplied or no confident match was found.
Longitude returned by the geocoding source for the selected location segment. Blank when no location was supplied or no confident match was found.

Point geometry built from geocoded latitude and longitude for mapping. Blank when no location was supplied or no confident match was found. For multi-location rows, this is the first Census-matched segment unless geocode_status indicates a later segment.
Geocoding outcome: matched, matched_first_of_multiple, matched_later_segment, unmatched, or no_location.
Geocoding service and benchmark used to create the mapping fields.
Address text submitted to the geocoder, usually parsed from the first semicolon-delimited location segment.
Normalized address returned by the geocoding source for the selected match.
One-based position of the semicolon-delimited location segment that produced the geocode match.
Number of candidate matches returned by the geocoder for the selected geocode query.
